counterevidence_considered.description: A complemented panel copy does exist in the workflow (complement_values = 1 - panel), which is the construct that would produce the in-scope issue if it fed the emission; on inspection it feeds only the complement_flags QC count (reported as 5), and never the agreement rate or emission product.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: complement_values used only in complement_flags; reported complement check count 5 matches the 5 supplied-coding mismatches

source_refs.quoted_text: complement_values = [1 - panel_values[index] for index in positions]
complement_flags = [match_selector(observed_values[index], complement_values[index]) for index in positions]
Complement check count (observed call equals 1 - staged panel value): 5

evidence.description: The emission accumulation and the agreement count are both computed against panel_values (the staged panel_gyra_marker column read as-is), not against the complemented copy.
evidence.observed_value: emission_factors and agreement_flags both compare observed_values[index] to panel_values[index]

emission_factors = [emission_selector(observed_values[index], panel_values[index]) for index in positions]

evidence.description: Independent recount from inputs/data.csv: phenotype_resistant equals panel_gyra_marker as staged for 19 of 24 isolates (mismatches at EC-04, EC-09, EC-13, EC-18, EC-22), matching the reported agreement count 19, rate 19/24 = 0.791667, and emission product (1/2)^5 = 1/32.
evidence.observed_value: 19/24 agreement against the supplied-coding panel; 5 mismatches; (1/2)^5 = 1/32

Units whose observed call equals the staged panel value: 19

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I tried to show the issue is present by tracing every use of complement_values: it appears only in complement_flags (line 39), which feeds complement_count in the Quality control section; agreement_flags (line 38) and emission_factors (line 40) both take panel_values directly. I also recomputed the agreement count by hand from the 24 data rows against the panel column as staged and got 19/24 with mismatches at EC-04, EC-09, EC-13, EC-18, EC-22, exactly reproducing the reported rate 0.791667 and emission 1/32 = (1/2)^5. Had the complement entered the emission, the rate would have been 5/24 and the product (1/2)^19; neither appears anywhere in the report. The falsification failed, so the no-issue verdict stands.
